<span class="origin-badge origin-badge--onesimus">Onesimus extension</span>

Toggle gRPC mode.

## Synopsis

```text
.grpc [on | off] [format=<json|text>] [compact=<yes|no>]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Switches the console connection to the gRPC message format, or shows its state.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `on` | keyword |  |  | one of: switch | Switch on. |
| `off` | keyword |  |  | one of: switch | Switch off. |
| `format=` | enum | `json`, `text` |  |  | Output format. |
| `compact=` | bool | `yes`, `no` |  |  | Compact JSON. |

## Examples

The state of the session and whether the gRPC service is enabled:

```text
.grpc
```

Switch to gRPC mode with compact JSON:

```text
.grpc on compact=yes
```

Return to the API mode used before .grpc on:

```text
.grpc off
```
